name: Annegret Ziegler
bio:
Annegret Ziegler's path to motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a childhood fascination with race cars, fueled by watching races with her father. After completing her degree in business administration, she cut her teeth in corporate finance before seeking a more exciting challenge. Her meticulous nature and sharp analytical skills quickly made her an asset in the fast-paced world of racing. 

Joining Full Time Sports was a dream come true. Annegret believes in a proactive approach to financial management, constantly seeking ways to optimize budgets and identify potential revenue streams. She is known for her ability to remain calm under pressure and her dedication to ensuring the team's financial stability. Annegret's commitment to the team's success is unwavering, and she's willing to put in the hours to achieve that success. 

Annegret is also an innovator. She is constantly looking for ways to improve the financial performance of the team, and she is always willing to experiment with new ideas. Her reliable nature makes her a great asset for the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Annegret has a warm smile and a professional demeanor.

quirks: Always has a cup of herbal tea on her desk.
Refers to financial reports as 'the team's heartbeat.'
